paw.en: The dog lifted one paw when it stepped onto the cold floor.
paw.zh: 狗踩到冰冷地板時抬起了一隻腳掌。

payment.en: The website confirmed our payment immediately after the order was placed.
payment.zh: 下單後，網站立刻確認了我們的付款。

pea.en: A single pea rolled off the plate and onto the table.
pea.zh: 一顆豌豆從盤子滾到桌面上。

pizza.en: We shared a large pizza after finishing the group project.
pizza.zh: 完成小組專題後，我們一起分吃了一大張披薩。

placement.en: Careful placement of the lights improved the quality of the photograph.
placement.zh: 仔細安排燈光位置提升了照片品質。

plague.en: The history lesson examined how plague outbreaks changed medieval cities.
plague.zh: 歷史課探討瘟疫爆發如何改變中世紀城市。

punishment.en: The teacher explained that punishment should be fair and related to behavior.
punishment.zh: 老師說明處罰應該公平，並與行為本身相關。

pupil.en: Each pupil received a worksheet before the science activity began.
pupil.zh: 科學活動開始前，每位學生都拿到一張學習單。

recognition.en: Her research gained recognition after it was presented at the conference.
recognition.zh: 她的研究在會議發表後獲得肯定。

recommendation.en: The librarian gave me a recommendation for a book about climate science.
recommendation.zh: 圖書館員推薦我一本關於氣候科學的書。

recorder.en: We used a digital recorder to capture the interview clearly.
recorder.zh: 我們用數位錄音機清楚錄下這次訪談。

referendum.en: The article explains how a referendum allows citizens to vote directly.
referendum.zh: 這篇文章說明公投如何讓公民直接投票。

refinement.en: The final design was the result of repeated testing and refinement.
refinement.zh: 最終設計是多次測試與改良的成果。

reflection.en: Writing a short reflection helped me understand what I learned.
reflection.zh: 寫一篇短心得幫助我了解自己學到了什麼。

refresh.en: A short walk outside can refresh your attention before studying again.
refresh.zh: 到外面短暫散步可以讓你在重新讀書前恢復專注。

refreshment.en: The organizers provided light refreshment during the afternoon break.
refreshment.zh: 主辦單位在下午休息時間提供簡單茶點。

refrigerator.en: Put the leftover soup in the refrigerator before it gets too warm.
refrigerator.zh: 剩下的湯在變得太溫之前要放進冰箱。

repetition.en: Careful repetition can help students remember new vocabulary more easily.
repetition.zh: 適度重複可以幫助學生更容易記住新單字。

replacement.en: The school ordered a replacement for the broken classroom projector.
replacement.zh: 學校為故障的教室投影機訂購了替代品。

reporter.en: The reporter interviewed residents about changes in the neighborhood.
reporter.zh: 記者訪問居民，了解社區中的變化。

resent.en: People may resent rules that seem unfair or poorly explained.
resent.zh: 人們可能會對看似不公平或說明不清的規定感到不滿。

resentment.en: Open communication can prevent small disagreements from turning into resentment.
resentment.zh: 坦誠溝通可以避免小爭執演變成怨恨。

reservation.en: We made a reservation for the museum workshop before all seats filled.
reservation.zh: 我們在名額額滿前預約了博物館工作坊。

retire.en: The coach plans to retire after working at the school for thirty years.
retire.zh: 這位教練在學校工作三十年後打算退休。

retirement.en: She hopes to travel more often after her retirement next year.
retirement.zh: 她希望明年退休後能更常旅行。

retort.en: His quick retort made the audience laugh during the friendly debate.
retort.zh: 他在友善辯論中的機智回應逗笑了觀眾。

seesaw.en: Two children took turns riding the seesaw in the playground.
seesaw.zh: 兩個孩子在遊樂場輪流玩翹翹板。

segment.en: The documentary includes a short segment about coral reef conservation.
segment.zh: 這部紀錄片有一小段介紹珊瑚礁保育。

seize.en: Officials may seize illegal goods found during a border inspection.
seize.zh: 官員在邊境檢查時可能扣押查獲的違法物品。

sensor.en: A temperature sensor records changes inside the greenhouse every minute.
sensor.zh: 溫度感測器每分鐘記錄溫室內的變化。

sentiment.en: Public sentiment changed after new evidence became available.
sentiment.zh: 新證據出現後，民意有所改變。

sentimental.en: The old photograph has sentimental value because it belonged to my grandmother.
sentimental.zh: 這張老照片因屬於祖母而具有情感價值。

separation.en: The glass wall creates a clear separation between the two study areas.
separation.zh: 玻璃牆在兩個學習區之間形成清楚分隔。

settle.en: The two groups met to settle their disagreement through discussion.
settle.zh: 兩組人透過討論見面解決彼此的歧見。

settlement.en: The ancient settlement grew beside a river that provided fresh water.
settlement.zh: 這個古代聚落在能提供淡水的河流旁發展。

settler.en: The diary describes a settler building a small farm near the coast.
settler.zh: 日記描述一名移民在海岸附近建立小農場。

remarkable.en: The scientist made remarkable progress despite limited equipment and funding.
remarkable.zh: 這位科學家在設備與經費有限的情況下仍取得卓越進展。

remedy.en: The simplest remedy for the printing error was to replace the page.
remedy.zh: 解決印刷錯誤最簡單的方法是更換那一頁。

reminder.en: I set a reminder so I would not forget the deadline.
reminder.zh: 我設定了提醒，以免忘記截止日期。

somebody.en: Somebody left a blue notebook on the library table after lunch.
somebody.zh: 午餐後，有人把一本藍色筆記本留在圖書館桌上。

someday.en: She hopes to study marine biology abroad someday.
someday.zh: 她希望有一天能到國外學習海洋生物學。

somehow.en: We somehow finished the project before the final deadline.
somehow.zh: 我們不知怎地在最後期限前完成了專題。

smash.en: A falling branch could smash the window during a strong storm.
smash.zh: 強風暴中掉落的樹枝可能砸破窗戶。

smell.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the bakery early in the morning.
smell.zh: 清晨時，新鮮麵包的香味充滿整間麵包店。

smile.en: Her friendly smile made the new student feel more welcome.
smile.zh: 她友善的微笑讓新同學感到更受歡迎。

waterfall.en: The trail ends beside a waterfall hidden deep in the forest.
waterfall.zh: 這條步道終點在森林深處一座瀑布旁。

watermelon.en: We cut the watermelon into slices for the summer picnic.
watermelon.zh: 我們把西瓜切成片，帶去夏日野餐。

waterproof.en: This waterproof jacket kept me dry during the sudden rainstorm.
waterproof.zh: 這件防水外套讓我在突如其來的暴雨中保持乾燥。

lousy.en: The lousy weather forced the outdoor concert to move inside.
lousy.zh: 糟糕的天氣迫使戶外音樂會移到室內舉行。

marry.en: The biography says the two writers chose to marry after college.
marry.zh: 傳記提到兩位作家大學畢業後選擇結婚。
